paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.32 as of July 23, 2026, with a decrease of 3.95% from the prior close and 20.9% over the last 21 sessions. There have been 2 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news articles have focused on Project Matador, a 17-gigawatt AI campus in the Texas Panhandle, with one article discussing the potential environmental impact of the project and another reporting on Fermi officials meeting with community leaders to discuss the project.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been 1 Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings in the feed.
